newsitem.title: MAURITANIA: Mauritania president sacks foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Mauritania president sacks foreign minister.

text.p: Mauritania's president, Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya, sacked his foreign minister on Sunday, according to a decree from the presidency.
The decree gave no reason for the replacement of Ahmed Sidi Ould Khalifa by Rural Development Minister Abdallahi Ould Nem.
Ahmed Salem Ould Saleck, entering the government for the first time, replaces Nem.

The same decree announced the sacking of the six members of the consultative High Islamic Counci, which watches over religious matters for the government. Once again, the decree gave no reason for the move.
Taya and his ruling party won a landslide victory in legislative elections in October in the former French colony which straddles black and Arab Africa.
His current six-year term of office ends in January 1998. There is no limit on the number of times he can stand.
